title: Appeals and Grievances Reviewer Bulletin: Payment at Issue on the Line of a Decided Late-Filing Reconsideration
content:
Appeals and Grievances reviewer bulletin: payment at issue on the case's line

Applies to a formal review asked for on a decided Claim Factual Reconsideration of a TRICARE Select line denied for late filing.

> The payment at issue on the case's line is figured by one of three methods: where the other insurer's payment counted is at least the allowed amount at issue, no payment is at issue; where a payment by another insurer below the allowed amount at issue is counted, the cost share is figured on the allowed amount at issue less that payment and the payment at issue is that net amount less the cost share; in every other case the cost share is figured on the allowed amount at issue itself and the payment at issue is the allowed amount at issue less the cost share; each amount is rounded to the cent.

The tier whose schedule figures apply is the tier of the TRICARE Select enrollment the case's line was billed under.

| Other insurer's payment counted | Amount the cost share is figured on | Payment at issue |
|---|---|---|
| at least the allowed amount at issue (equal counts) | — | none (0.00) |
| above zero and below the allowed amount at issue | the allowed amount at issue less the payment counted | that net amount less the cost share |
| none | the allowed amount at issue | the allowed amount at issue less the cost share |

**Boundary on the first method (hypothetical allowed amount 300.00):** a counted payment of 299.99 is below the allowed amount, so the second method applies — net 0.01, and the payment at issue is that net amount less the cost share figured on it; a counted payment of 300.00 meets the allowed amount, so no payment is at issue.
